label: OnePlus 12 smartphone
description: OnePlus 12 — 6.82-inch Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 flagship, Wi-Fi 7 and 5G sub-6 GHz; USB-C 3.2 with Ethernet over adapter.
notes: Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be, 2x2, 2.4/5/6 GHz, 320 MHz, MLO). Cellular: 5G sub-6 GHz (mmWave only on select North American carrier SKUs), LTE Cat 20. USB-C 3.2 Gen 1 with Ethernet adapter support (usb0). OxygenOS keeps Wi-Fi and cellular up simultaneously by default — model as dual-active for failover tests.
